answer: A practical sybil defense is to require each agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can earn, with the stake slashed when peers detect duplicate identities. Like a comet that leaves a visible trail, every action is logged on a shared ledger, so a whisper of coordination among fake accounts becomes easy to spot. Juniper-style reputation then grows only from sustained, attested work over time, making it expensive to spin up many fresh identities at once while honest agents keep their stake and history.
